title: 人工智能在机械工程中的应用：基础、机遇、挑战与责任
summary: 该文基于COBEM 2025圆桌讨论，系统梳理AI在机械工程建模、仿真、优化与诊断中的应用，区分统计学习与人类认知，探讨工业采纳、物理约束建模、验证与不确定性量化、认证、能源可持续性及伦理责任，强调AI应补充而非替代工程判断。
summary_en: Based on a round-table at COBEM 2025, this article examines how AI enhances mechanical engineering practice—modeling, simulation, optimization, diagnostics—while distinguishing statistical learning from human cognition. It covers industrial adoption, physics-informed and hybrid learning, validation, uncertainty quantification, certification, energy sustainability, and ethical responsibility, concluding that AI should complement, not replace, engineering judgment.
